_doc.purpose: Inputs for tools/build_service_area.py, which writes service_area.geojson: the land inside the emirates the demo serves. Every generated point must fall inside it.
_doc.emirates: OSM boundary relations (admin_level 4) for the emirates served (Dubai + northern emirates; no Abu Dhabi). name -> relation id.
_doc.coastline_bbox: [south, west, north, east] for the OSM natural=coastline download; must cover both coasts of the served emirates.
_doc.sea_seeds: [lat, lon] points known to be open sea; polygon faces containing one are water.
_doc.simplify_deg: Douglas-Peucker tolerance in degrees for the written geometry (0.0002 deg is about 20 m).
_doc.source: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (Nominatim for boundaries, Overpass for coastline).
